notes: Change-request rounds per PR from Amit (amit-kotidev) review verdicts across 86 reviewed PRs. Amit posts verdicts as COMMENTED reviews with emoji markers (🔴 BLOCK / 🟡 REQUEST CHANGES / 🟢 CLEAN/APPROVE-WITH-NOTES), not formal GitHub CHANGES_REQUESTED. A round = a review whose Verdict/TL;DR line demands a fix before merge (REQUEST CHANGES / FIX-THEN-SHIP / BLOCK / CONDITIONAL). Most PRs (74/86) land clean on Amit's read because heavy self-review + TDD happens pre-PR; the tail (2-3 rounds) is money-path/executor and de-hallucination work. p50=0, p90=1, max=3.
